periods.name: This Afternoon
periods.text: Mostly sunny, with a high near 83. Southwest wind around 12 mph, with gusts as high as 18 mph. New rainfall amounts less than a tenth of an inch possible.

periods.name: Tonight
periods.text: Showers and thunderstorms. Some of the storms could be severe. Mostly cloudy. Low around 48, with temperatures rising to around 54 overnight. Northwest wind 7 to 12 mph, with gusts as high as 20 mph. Chance of precipitation is 80%. New rainfall amounts between a tenth and quarter of an inch possible.

readiness.hed: Severe Thunderstorm Watch is up for Fredericksburg until 8 p.m. Storms tonight could be severe.
readiness.insight: NWS Baltimore/Washington has Severe Thunderstorm Watch 686 in effect for the City of Fredericksburg until 8 p.m. EDT. This afternoon is mostly sunny, a high near 83, southwest wind around 12 mph. Tonight is showers and thunderstorms, an 80 percent chance, and some storms could be severe, with a low around 48. Saturday is a chance of showers before 11 a.m., then partly sunny, a high near 55, north wind gusting to 28 mph. Saturday night's low is around 37.
